findings.evidence: Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/FDRep.lean:135 `theorem forget₂_ρ (V : FDRep R G) : ((forget₂ (FDRep R G) (Rep R G)).obj V).ρ = V.ρ := by ext g v; rfl`; FiniteDimensional.lean:279-280 states the field type via `(forget₂ …).obj object`, and the only comment at 288 concerns universes.
findings.fix: Document the reliance at the `equiv` field (as `character_forget₂` in Character.lean does for the analogous step), or add a private bridging lemma in the style this file already uses (`forget₂_map_forget₂HomLinearEquiv`, `indFDRepForgetIso_hom_hom_apply`) stating `((forget₂ …).obj (FDRep.of ρ)).ρ = ρ` by `rfl` and go through it.
findings.issue: `exact { object := FDRep.of ρ, equiv := shrinkRepEquiv V.ρ }` typechecks only because `((forget₂ (FDRep k G) (Rep k G)).obj (FDRep.of ρ)).ρ` is definitionally `ρ` (and its carrier definitionally `Shrink V`). Mathlib records that identification as the lemma `FDRep.forget₂_ρ`, proved `by ext g v; rfl` — not as `rfl` — so the whole small-model comparison rests on an undocumented defeq across the `FDRep.of`/`forget₂` wrappers.

findings.evidence: FiniteDimensional.lean:400-406 state `map f = eqToHom (indFDRepFunctor_obj A) ≫ indFDRepMap f ≫ eqToHom (indFDRepFunctor_obj B).symm := (rfl)`; the removed docstring block is visible in the diff hunk for `indFDRepFunctor`.
findings.fix: Restore an explanatory comment (why the `eqToHom` casts are needed at all if `rfl` closes the goal), or generate both projections with `@[simps obj map]` as before instead of hand-writing them.
findings.issue: `indFDRepFunctor_map` (and `indFDRepFunctor_obj`, line 397) are closed by a bare `(rfl)`. For the map lemma this needs `eqToHom (indFDRepFunctor_obj _)` — whose proof is not syntactically `rfl` — to reduce to `𝟙`, plus identity composition in `FDRep` to be definitional; nothing says so, and the diff deleted the comment that previously explained exactly this design (`@[simps obj map]` … "the type of the second needs `indFDRepFunctor.obj A` to reduce to `indFDRep A`").

summary: The refactor keeps the documented-`change` discipline and replaces the old `change …; infer_instance` hack with named lemmas, but two new spots close goals by definitional equality with no note: the `IndSmallModel` construction silently needs `FDRep.forget₂_ρ` to hold by `rfl`, and the hand-written functor projections are closed by bare `(rfl)` after the comment explaining that design was deleted.
